promo.heading: About TRP
promo.text: SRM TRP Engineering College is headed by Dr. R. Shivakumar M.D., Ph.D. Chairman, Ramapuram and Trichy Campuses. The institution continues the blazing glory in the field of education, deservedly bequeathing it from SRM Group of Institutions. It is approved by All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), New Delhi and affiliated to Anna University, Chennai.
